name: Oracle trust scorer
description: Publishes signed, ephemeral Nostr reviews (-1/0/+1 with comment) of any registry listing, and computes a client-side reputation score for a listing weighted by review recency and reviewer key continuity. Scoring is local and tunable; nothing is enforced network-wide.

spec.install: git clone https://github.com/Technosophorso/oracle.git && cd oracle && npm install
commands: npm run trust -- score <listing-tx-id> [--relays url,url] [--half-life-days n]
